name: Own-savings standing order the salary account cannot fund, no spare money anywhere (G422)

expected.notes: G422 (Kevin 2026-11-06). The same day, accounts and standing order as the covered scenario, but Monzo Current holds 0, so no account anywhere can spare anything. Barclays: 50 - 250 = -200 after payments and at the low point, short, and the only bounced item is a movement into savings (never a payment at risk, at risk count 0). Gap 200, target 210. The finder needs a source with at least 5 of headroom above its 10 cushion: Monzo has 0 - 10 = -10, Barclays Saver is the account the order pays into so it is never a source, so there are no legs: no move card, no earmark, no covered-by-move. The account carries the savings at risk fact with no_cover true, whose note reads 'There may not be enough to fund this savings transfer this period. You could pause or cancel the standing order with your bank for this month.' (recommendation in words only). Left to spend: pool 50 + 0 = 50, less the 250 leaving it = -200. Nothing is spendable so Spend from is 0 on both current accounts. The payday plan is unchanged (null). G436 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the Left to spend and Spend from figures worked above where they differ: Barclays has no cover, so its own figure stays -200 (after payments -200, low point -200) instead of the old floor of 0; Monzo is 0 (balance 0, nothing leaves it). Left to spend is their sum, -200 + 0 = -200, unchanged. G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the savings at risk reading above: the order is an ordinary predicted payment, so Barclays is an ordinary shortfall of 200 with no source that can spare anything: no move and no earmark, exactly as before. The savings at risk fact and its no-cover sentence are gone. Figures are unchanged (Barclays -200, Monzo 0, Left to spend -200, at risk count 0). G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07): the bounced 250 order counts as a payment at risk: at risk count 1 (was 0). Barclays 50 - 250 = -200, one bounce.
